description: This PHP source file defines a command class for toggling the system check screen in the OrangeHRM platform. It extends a console command base class, includes traits for configuration services, and implements logic to enable or disable a system check screen via command-line options.

classes.name: ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand
classes.description: A console command class in OrangeHRM that allows administrators to toggle the visibility of the system check screen via CLI.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CLI command.
